%20events.%20A%20fine%20or%20a%20penalty%20of%200%20is%20unexpected%20from%20a%20business%20point%20of%20view.%0A%20%20%20%20-%20At%20*Payment*%2C%20%60paymentAmount%60%20is%20%600%60%20in%20**3**%20events%20and%20%60totalPaymentAmount%60%20is%20%600%60%20in%20**2**%20events.%20A%20payment%20of%200%2C%20or%20a%20cumulative%20payment%20total%20of%200%20*after*%20a%20payment%2C%20contradicts%20the%20meaning%20of%20the%20activity%20(data%20error%2C%20or%20cancellation%2Fcorrection%3F).%0A%20%20%20%20-%20%60expense%60%20is%20%600%60%20in%20**2'860%20of%20103'987**%20*Send%20Fine*%20events%20(about%202.8%20%25).%20Possibly%20these%20fines%20were%20delivered%20without%20postal%20costs%2C%20or%20the%20costs%20were%20not%20recorded.%0A%20%20%20%20-%20%60matricola%60%20is%20%600%60%20in%20all%20**555**%20*Appeal%20to%20Judge*%20events%20and%20therefore%20carries%20no%20information%20at%20all.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Conclusion%3A**%20The%20hypothesis%20is%20partly%20confirmed.%20Truly%20missing%20values%20are%20rare%2C%20but%20%600%60%20is%20used%20as%20a%20default%20value%20and%20possibly%20hides%20missing%20information.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Findings%3A**%0A%0A%20%20%20%20-%20Why%20is%20%60lastSent%60%20missing%20in%201'631%20notifications%3F%20Do%20these%20cases%20take%20a%20different%20course%3F%0A%20%20%20%20-%20Inspect%20the%20cases%20with%20%60amount%20%3D%200%60.%0A%20%20%20%20-%20Inspect%20the%203%20*Payment*%20events%20with%20%60paymentAmount%20%3D%200%60%3A%20do%20they%20belong%20to%20the%202%20events%20with%20%60totalPaymentAmount%20%3D%200%60%3F%20(relevant%20for%20Task%202.4b)%0A%20%20%20%20-%20Do%20cases%20with%20%60expense%20%3D%200%60%20differ%20in%20their%20further%20course%2C%20e.g.%20at%20*Insert%20Fine%20Notification*%3F%0A%20%20%20%20-%20*Recommendation%20data%20collection%3A*%20Store%20values%20that%20were%20not%20recorded%20as%20empty%20(%60NULL%60)%20instead%20of%20%600%60%2C%20so%20that%20%22not%20present%22%20and%20%22not%20recorded%22%20can%20be%20disting t%20was%20recorded%20by%20resource%20537.%20%60dismissal%20%3D%20NIL%60%20is%20the%20initial%20value%20(no%20dismissal)%2C%20%60totalPaymentAmount%20%3D%200%60%20(nothing%20paid%20yet).%0A%20%20%20%20-%20**17.07.2007%2C%20Send%20Fine%3A**%20The%20fine%20is%20only%20sent%20**119%20days**%20after%20it%20was%20issued.%20This%20causes%20postal%20expenses%20of%20**13%20%E2%82%AC**%20(%60expense%60).%0A%20%20%20%20-%20**23.07.2007%2C%20Insert%20Fine%20Notification%3A**%20**6%20days**%20after%20the%20fine%20was%20sent%2C%20the%20notification%20is%20registered.%20The%20recipient%20is%20the%20car%20owner%20(%60notificationType%20%3D%20P%60).%20%60lastSent%60%20also%20has%20the%20value%20P.%0A%20%20%20%20-%20**21.09.2007%2C%20Add%20penalty%3A**%20Exactly%20**60%20days**%20after%20the%20notification%20a%20penalty%20is%20added.%20%60amount%60%20rises%20to%20**44%20%E2%82%AC**%2C%20i.e.%20to%20twice%20the%20original%20fine.%20This%20fits%20a%20payment%20deadline%20of%2060%20days%20that%20has%20passed%20without%20a%20payment.%0A%20%20%20%20-%20**01.10.2007%2C%20Payment%3A**%2010%20days%20later%20the%20owner%20pays%20**35%20%E2%82%AC**%20(%60totalPaymentAmount%20%3D%2035%60).%20This%20is%20exactly%20the%20original%20fine%20plus%20the%20postal%20expenses%20(22%20%2B%2013).%0A%20%20%20%20-%20**31.10.2007%2C%20Payment%3A**%20One%20month%20later%20a%20second%20payment%20of%20**22%20%E2%82%AC**%20follows.%20In%20total%20**57%20%E2%82%AC**%20have%20now%20been%20paid%2C%20which%20is%20exactly%20the%20total%20amount%20due%3A%2044%20%E2%82%AC%20(fine%20including%20penalty)%20%2B%2013%20%E2%82%AC%20(expenses).%20The%20case%20is%20closed.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Interpretation%3A**%20The%20hypothesis%20is%20confirmed.%20The%20case%20follows%20the%20expected%20course%2C%20and%20the%20amounts%20are%20consistent%3A%20%60amount%60%20is%20cumulative%20(fine%20including%20penalty)%2C%20%60totalPaymentAmount%60%20sums%20up%20the%20payments%20correctly%2C%20and%20at%20the%20end%20no%20amount%20is%20outstanding.%20The%20first%20payment%20is%20exactly%20the%20amount%20*without*%20the%20penalty.%20Presumably%20the%20owner%20first%20settled%20only%20the%20original%20claim%20without%20knowing%20about%20the%20penalty%2C%20and%20paid%20the%20penalty%20afterwards.%20The%20whole%20case%20takes%20**225%20days**%2C%20of%20which%20119%20days%20alone%20pass%20before%20the%20fine%20is%20sent.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Findings%3A**%0A%0A%20%20%20%20-%20Almost%204%20months%20lie%20between%20*Create%20Fine*%20and%20*Send%20Fine*.%20How%20long%20does%20this%20take%20on%20average%2C%20and%20are%20there%20legal%20deadlines%20for%20it%3F%20(candidate%20for%20the%20performance%20analysis%20in%20Session%206)%0A%20%20%20%20-%20%60lastSent%60%20(meaning%20unknown)%20agrees%20with%20%60notificationType%60%20in%20this%20case%20(P).%20A%20cross%20table%20over%20all%2079'860%20*Insert%20Fine%20Notification*%20events%20shows%2C%20however%2C%20that%20this%20does%20not%20hold%20in%20general%3A%20the%20values%20are%20equal%20in%20only%20about%2058%20%25%20of%20the%20cases.%20%60lastSent%60%20also%20has%20an%20additional%20value%20**N**%20(30'313%20events%2C%20almost%20all%20of%20them%20with%20%60notificationType%20%3D%20P%60)%2C%20and%20in%201'380%20cases%20%60notificationType%20%3D%20P%60%20occurs%20together%20with%20%60lastSent%20%3D%20C%60%2C%20but%20never%20the%20other%20way%20round.%20So%20the%20attribute%20is%20not%20redundant%2C%20but%20its%20meaning%20remains%20unclear.%20*Recommendation%20data%20collection%3A*%20document%20the%20attributes%20and%20their%20value%20ranges.%0A%20%20%20%20-%20Do%20offenders%20often%20pay%20only%20the%20original%20amount%20first%20after%20a%20penalty%20has%20been%20added%3F%20This%20could%20point%20to%20an%20unclear%20communication%20of%20the%20penalty%20(suggestion%20for%20improving%20the%20process).%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(ACTIVITY%2C%20event_log%2C%20pd)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20_notif%20%3D%20event_log%5Bevent_log%5BAC The%20stored%20total%20shows%2098%20and%20then%20136%2C%20so%20the%20first%20payment%20is%20counted%20twice.%20Here%20the%20stored%20total%20is%20wrong.%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20-%20**C17607%3A**%20The%20offender%20pays%20instalments%20of%2050.%20At%20the%20eleventh%20the%20stored%20total%20jumps%20from%20500%20to%20600%2C%20and%20the%20last%20payment%20brings%20it%20to%20687.75%2C%20exactly%20the%20initial%20fine%20amount.%20A%20*Payment*%20event%20of%2050%20seems%20to%20be%20missing.%20Here%20the%20stored%20total%20is%20right%20and%20the%20log%20is%20incomplete.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Of%20the%20three%20payments%20with%20%60paymentAmount%20%3D%200%60%20(Task%202.2a)%20only%20one%20deviates%20(S89610%2C%20stored%20total%2033.6).%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Conclusion.**%20The%20hypothesis%20is%20partly%20confirmed.%20%60totalPaymentAmount%60%20is%20correct%20for%2099.88%20%25%20of%20the%20*Payment*%20events%2C%20and%20same-day%20payments%20cause%20deviations%20as%20expected.%20We%20did%20not%20expect%20that%20they%20explain%20less%20than%20a%20third%20of%20the%20deviations%20and%20that%20in%2050%20cases%20the%20stored%20total%20and%20the%20payment%20events%20contradict%20each%20other.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Findings%3A**%0A%0A%20%20%20%20-%20The%20log%20alone%20cannot%20tell%20a%20double-counted%20payment%20from%20a%20missing%20*Payment*%20event.%20The%2050%20cases%20should%20be%20checked%20against%20the%20source%20system.%20Are%20*Payment*%20events%20also%20missing%20in%20cases%20where%20no%20stored%20total%20reveals%20it%3F%0A%20%20%20%20-%20*Recommendation%20data%20collection%3A*%20Validate%20a%20derived%20total%20when%20it%20is%20written%2C%20and%20record%20the%20time%20of%20day%20(Task%202.1)%20so%20that%20payments%20on%20the%20same%20day%20can%20be%20ordered.%0A%20%20%20%20-%20For%20Task%202.5%20we%20use%20our%20own%20sum%20%60cum_payment_amount%60%2C%20because%20it%20is%20defined%20for%20every%20event.%20The%20choice%20only%20matters%20for%20the%2050%20cases%20above.%0A%20%20 e_log_t5%5B'start_time'%5D.dt.tz_convert('Europe%2FRome').dt.year.rename('year%20of%20Create%20Fine')%0A%20%20%20%20_per_year%20%3D%20pd.DataFrame(%7B%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20'cases'%3A%20_amount.groupby(_year).size()%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20'most%20frequent%20initial_amount'%3A%20_amount.groupby(_year).agg(lambda%20s%3A%20s.mode().iloc%5B0%5D)%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20'share%20of%20this%20amount%20%25'%3A%20_amount.groupby(_year).agg(lambda%20s%3A%20round(100%20*%20s.value_counts().iloc%5B0%5D%20%2F%20len(s)%2C%201))%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%7D)%0A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.vstack(%5B%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20mo.md(f%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20-%20Distinct%20values%20of%20%60initial_amount%60%3A%20**%7B_amount.nunique()%7D**%0A%20%20%20%20-%20Skewness%3A%20**%7B_amount.skew()%3A.1f%7D**%0A%20%20%20%20-%20Cases%20with%20an%20initial%20amount%20of%200%3A%20**%7B(_amount%20%3D%3D%200).sum()%7D**%2C%20of%20500%20or%20more%3A%20**%7B(_amount%20%3E%3D%20500).sum()%7D**%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20_amount.describe(percentiles%3D%5B.05%2C%20.25%2C%20.5%2C%20.75%2C%20.95%2C%20.99%5D).round(2)%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20mo.md(%22The%20eight%20most%20frequent%20values%3A%22)%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20_top_table%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20mo.md(%22The%20most%20frequent%20value%20per%20year%3A%22)%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20_per_year%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%5D)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Task%202.5b%20(Part%203)%20-%20Result%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Visualization.**%20The%20amounts%20are%20discrete%2C%20so%20we%20plot%20the%20number%20of%20cases%20per%20amount%20in%20two%20histograms%3A%20the%20range%20up%20to%20100%20with%20a%20linear%20y-axis%20(95%20%25%20of%20the%20cases)%2C%20and%20the%20full%20range%20with%20a%20logarithmic%20y-axis%2C%20which%20makes%20the%20rare%20high%20amounts%20visible.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Observation%201%3A%20the%20distribution%20consists%20of%20a%20few%20spikes.**%20The%20150'370%20cases%20share%20only%20113%20distinct%20amounts%2C%20and%20the%20eight%20most%20frequent%20ones%20(31.30%2C%2032%2C%2032.80%2C%2033.60%2C%2035%2C%2036%2C%2038%20and%2039)%20cover%2075.8%20%25%20of%20all%20cases.%20Half%20of%20the%20cases%20lie%20between%2032.80%20and%2038%20(lower%20and%20upper%20quartile).%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Observation%202%3A%20the%20spikes%20are%20one%20standard%20fine%20that%20is%20raised%20over%20time%2C%20not%20eight%20different%20offences.**%20In%20every%20year%20a%20single%20amount%20dominates%2C%20and%20it%20rises%20stepwise%3A%2031.30%20(2000)%2C%2032.80%20(2001)%2C%2032%20(2002)%2C%2033.60%20(2003%20and%202004)%2C%2035%20(2005%20and%202006)%2C%2036%20(2007%20and%202008)%2C%2038%20(2009%20and%202010)%2C%2039%20(2011%20and%202012)%20and%2041%20(2013).%20From%202003%20on%20the%20step%20comes%20every%20two%20years.%20Amounts%20from%20different%20years%20are%20therefore%20not%20directly%20comparable.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Hypothesis.**%20Confirmed%3A%20the%20distribution%20is%20discrete%20and%20strongly%20right-skewed%20(skewness%2017.0).%2099%20%25%20of%20the%20fines%20are%20at%20most%20155%2C%20but%20364%20fines%20are%20500%20or%20more%20and%20the%20maximum%20is%204'351.%20We%20did%20not%20expect%20that%20the%20position%20of%20the%20main%20spike%20depends%20on%20the%20year.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Findings%3A**%0A%0A%20%20%20%20-%20The%20share%20of%20the%20dominant%20amount%20falls%20from%2087.9%20%25%20(2004%20and%202005)%20to%2050.3%20%25%20(2011).%20Did%20the%20mix%20of%20offences%20change%2C%20or%20were%20additional%20tariffs%20introduced%3F%0A%20%20%20%20-%20The%2036%20fines%20with%20an%20amount%20of%200%20and%20the%20364%20fines%20of%20500%20or%20more%20should%20be%20inspected%20(see%20Task%201.1c).%0A%20%20%20%20-%20The%20standard%20amounts%20of%202000%20and%202001%20(31.30%20and%2032.80)%20are%20not%20round.%20They%20correspond%20to%2060'600%20and%2063'500%20lire%20(1%20EUR%20%3D%201'936.27%20lire)%2C%20which%20suggests%20that%20amounts%20from%20before%202002%20were%20recorded%20in%20lire%20and%20converted.%20See%20also%20Task%202.7.%0A%20%20%20%20-%20*Recommendation%3A*%20Compare%20amounts%20only%20within%20a%20year%2C%20or%20relative%20to%20the%20standard%20amount%20of%20the%20year.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%20Task%202.6%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Task%202.6%20-%20Hypothesis%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%60amount%60%20only%20changes%20at%20Add%20penalty%20(Task%202.2b)%2C%20and%20there%20it%20is%20about%20twice%20the%20initial%20amount.%20We%20therefore%20expect%20two%20groups%20of%20cases%20and%20nothing%20else%3A%20cases%20without%20a%20penalty%20on%20the%20line%20final%20%3D%20initial%2C%20and%20cases%20with%20a%20penalty%20close%20to%20the%20line%20final%20%3D%202%20x%20initial.%20The%20log%20has%2079'860%20Add%20penalty%20events%20for%20150'370%20cases%2C%20so%20we%20expect%20about%2053%20%25%20of%20the%20cases%20in%20the%20second%20group.%20No%20case%20should%20have%20a%20final%20amount%20below%20the%20initial%20amount.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(CASE_ID%2C%20case_log_t5%2C%20event_log)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20case_log_t6%20%3D%20case_log_t5.copy()%0A%20%20%20%20case_log_t6%5B'final_amount'%5D%20%3D%20event_log.groupby(CASE_ID)%5B'amount'%5D.last()%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20final%20amount%20as%20a%20multiple%20of%20the%20initial%20amount%20(not%20defined%20for%20an%20initial%20amount%20of%200)%0A%20%20%20%20case_log_t6%5B'amount_ratio'%5D%20%3D%20(%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20case_log_t6%5B'final_amount'%5D%20%2F%20case_log_t6%5B'initial_amount'%5D.where(case_log_t6%5B'initial_amount'%5D%20%3E%200)%0A%20%20%20%20).round(3)%0A%0A%20%20%20%20case_log_t6%5B%5B'initial_amount'%2C%20'final_amount'%2C%20'amount_ratio'%5D%5D.head(10)%0A%20%20%20%20return%20(case_log_t6%2C)%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef 20penalty.%20The%20share%20of%2053.1%20%25%20matches%20the%2079'860%20*Add%20penalty*%20events%20(79'842%20cases%20plus%20the%2018%20cases%20in%20which%20the%20amount%20is%200%20before%20and%20after%20the%20penalty).%20The%20hypothesis%20is%20confirmed.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20We%20did%20not%20expect%20that%20the%20penalty%20is%20not%20a%20surcharge%20that%20varies%20from%20case%20to%20case.%20The%20final%20amount%20is%20determined%20by%20the%20initial%20amount%3A%2099.7%20%25%20of%20the%20cases%20with%20a%20penalty%20have%20the%20most%20frequent%20final%20amount%20for%20their%20initial%20amount%2C%20e.g.%2035%20becomes%2071.50%2C%2036%20becomes%2074%2C%2038%20becomes%2077.50%20and%2033.60%20becomes%2068.77.%20The%20factor%20is%20close%20to%202%20but%20usually%20not%20exactly%202%20(only%2018.9%20%25%20of%20these%20cases%20are%20doubled%20exactly).%0A%0A%20%20%20%20A%20possible%20explanation%20from%20outside%20the%20log%20(our%20assumption%2C%20not%20verified%20against%20the%20legal%20text)%3A%20under%20the%20Italian%20traffic%20code%20the%20offender%20may%20pay%20the%20minimum%20of%20the%20statutory%20range%20of%20a%20fine%20within%2060%20days%20after%20the%20notification%2C%20and%20afterwards%20half%20of%20the%20statutory%20maximum%20is%20due.%20A%20range%20from%2036%20to%20148%20would%20give%20148%20%2F%202%20%3D%2074.%20This%20would%20also%20explain%20the%20ratios%20of%202.5%20and%204%20for%20some%20expensive%20offences%2C%20whose%20maximum%20is%20a%20different%20multiple%20of%20the%20minimum%2C%20and%20it%20fits%20the%2060%20days%20between%20notification%20and%20penalty%20in%20case%20A10009%20(Task%202.3).%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Findings%3A**%0A%0A%20%20%20%20-%2046.9%20%25%20of%20the%20cases%20never%20receive%20a%20penalty.%20Which%20of%20them%20were%20paid%20within%20the%20deadline%2C%20which%20were%20dismissed%2C%20and%20which%20were%20simply%20not%20followed%20up%20(compare%20the%2020'735%20cases%20that%20end%20with%20*Send%20Fine*%20in%20Task%202.5b%20of%20Part%202)% s%20157%20and%207%20never%20carry%20points.%20In%20article%20158%20only%201'619%20of%2026'990%20cases%20(6.0%20%25)%20carry%20points%2C%20and%20then%20always%20exactly%202.%20In%20article%20142%20(speed%20limits%2C%20according%20to%20the%20Italian%20traffic%20code)%201'247%20of%205'766%20cases%20(21.6%20%25)%20carry%20points%2C%20with%202%2C%203%2C%205%2C%206%20or%2010%20points.%20Cases%20with%20points%20have%20a%20median%20initial%20amount%20of%2080%2C%20cases%20without%20points%20one%20of%2035.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20So%20one%20article%20covers%20different%20offences%2C%20with%20and%20without%20points%20and%20with%20different%20numbers%20of%20points.%20The%20article%20number%20alone%20does%20not%20identify%20the%20offence.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Fact%202%20(%60expense%60)%3A%20the%20expense%20is%20not%20a%20fixed%20fee.%20It%20rises%20stepwise%20over%20the%20years%20and%20much%20faster%20than%20the%20fine.**%0A%0A%20%20%20%20103'987%20cases%20have%20an%20expense%20(the%20cases%20with%20a%20*Send%20Fine*%20event)%20and%2046'383%20have%20none.%20There%20are%2091%20distinct%20values%2C%20and%202'860%20cases%20have%20an%20expense%20of%200.%20The%20most%20frequent%20expense%20per%20year%20is%206.46%20(2000)%2C%206.71%20(2001)%2C%2010%20(2002%20and%202003)%2C%2011%20(2004%20to%202006)%2C%2013%20(2007)%2C%2013.50%20(2008%20to%202010)%2C%2015%20(2011%20and%202012)%20and%2016%20(2013).%20That%20is%20an%20increase%20of%20148%20%25%2C%20while%20the%20standard%20fine%20rose%20by%2031%20%25%20in%20the%20same%20period%20(from%2031.30%20to%2041).%20Relative%20to%20the%20standard%20fine%20the%20expense%20grows%20from%2020.6%20%25%20in%202000%20to%2039.0%20%25%20in%202013.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20values%20of%202000%20and%202001%20correspond%20to%2012'500%20and%2013'000%20lire%20(1%20EUR%20%3D%201'936.27%20lire).%20Together%20with%20the%20standard%20fines%20of%20these%20years%20(Task%202.5b%20of%20Part%203)%20and%20the%20frequent%20overpayment%20of%205.16%20%3D%2010'000%20lire%20(Task%202.5b%20of%20Part%202)%2C%20this%20suggests%20an%20answer%20to%20the%20currency%20question%20of%20Task%201.1c%3A%20the%20log%20is%20in%20euro%20throughout%2C%20and%20the%20values%20from%20before%202002%20were%20converted%20from%20lire.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Hypothesis.**%20Confirmed%20for%20%60article%60%20(parking%20offences%20dominate%2C%20points%20only%20for%20few%20articles).%20Not%20confirmed%20for%20%60expense%60%3A%20it%20is%20not%20one%20fixed%20value%20but%20changes%20over%20time.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Findings%3A**%0A%0A%20%20%20%20-%20*Recommendation%20data%20collection%3A*%20Record%20the%20offence%20more%20precisely%20than%20by%20the%20article%20number%20(e.g.%20the%20paragraph)%2C%20so%20that%20the%20points%20and%20the%20amount%20can%20be%20checked%20against%20the%20offence.%20Why%20do%20only%206%20%25%20of%20the%20cases%20of%20article%20158%20carry%20points%3F%0A%20%20%20%20-%20Why%20does%20the%20expense%20of%20the%20same%20year%20vary%20(91%20distinct%20values%2C%20and%202'860%20fines%20sent%20at%20an%20expense%20of%200)%3F%0A%20%20%20%20-%20*Improvement%20of%20the%20process%3A*%20In%202013%20the%20notification%20adds%2039%20%25%20to%20a%20standard%20fine.%20Offenders%20who%20pay%20before%20the%20fine%20is%20sent%20avoid%20this%20cost%2C%20and%20the%20police%20saves%20the%20postage.%20Making%20early%20payment%20easier%2C%20or%20notifying%20electronically%2C%20could%20reduce%20both%20the%20expenses%20and%20the%20number%20of%20open%20cases.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20Session%203%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%20Task%203.1%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Task%203.1%20-%20Definition%20of%20the%20outcomes%0A%0A%20%20%20%20From%20the%20point%20of%20view%20of%20the%20police%20a%20fine%20can%20end%20in%20three%20ways.%20We%20define%20one%20Boolean%20indicator%20per%20outcome%3A%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Outcome%20%7C%20Business%20meaning%20%7C%20Definition%20in%20the%20log%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C---%7C---%7C---%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20%60paid%60%20%7C%20The%20offender%20has%20paid%20everything%20that%20is%20due.%20%7C%20The%20case%20contains%20a%20*Payment*%2C%20and%20the%20outstanding%20amount%20after%20the%20last%20event%20is%200%20or%20less%20(Task%202.5%2C%20Part%202).%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20%60credit_collection%60%20%7C%20The%20fine%20was%20not%20paid%20and%20is%20handed%20over%20to%20a%20collection%20agency.%20%7C%20The%20case%20contains%20*Send%20for%20Credit%20Collection*.%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20%60dismissed%60%20%7C%20The%20fine%20is%20cancelled%20after%20an%20appeal.%20%7C%20An%20event%20of%20the%20case%20has%20the%20%60dismissal%60%20value%20%60%23%60%20(prefecture)%20or%20%60G%60%20(judge).%20%7C%0A%0A%20%20%20%20We%20deliberately%20do%20not%20define%20%60paid%60%20as%20%22the%20case%20contains%20a%20*Payment*%22.%20Task%202.5%20showed%20that%2016'642%20payments%20leave%20an%20amount%20outstanding%2C%20and%20a%20fine%20that%20is%20only%20partly%20paid%20is%20not%20settled%20from%20a%20business%20point%20of%20view.%20For%20%60dismissed%60%20we%20only%20use%20the%20two%20documented%20codes.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Task%203.1%20-%20Hypothesis%0A%0A%20%20%20%20From%20Task%202.5%20(Part%202)%20we%20expect%20about%2040%20%25%20of%20the%20cases%20to%20be%20%60paid%60%20(60'290%20cases%20end%20with%20an%20outstanding%20amount%20of%200%20or%20less)%20and%20about%2039%20%25%20to%20end%20in%20%60credit_collection%60%20(59'013%20*Send%20for%20Credit%20Collection*%20events).%20%60dismissed%60%20should%20be%20rare%2C%20below%202%20%25%20(2'577%20cases%20have%20a%20dismissal%20value%20other%20than%20NIL%2C%20including%20the%20undocumented%20codes).%20That%20leaves%20roughly%2020%20%25%20of%20the%20cases%20without%20any%20of%20the%20three%20outcomes%2C%20mainly%20the%20cases%20that%20end%20with%20*Send%20Fine*%20or%20with%20a%20*Payment*%20that%20does%20not%20cover%20the%20amount%20due%20(Task%202.5b).%0A%0A%20%20%20%20We%20expect%20the%20three%20outcomes%20to%20be%20almost%20mutually%20exclusive%3A%20a%20fine%20that%20is%20sent%20for%20credit%20collection%20is%20by%20definition%20unpaid%2C%20and%20a%20dismissed%20fine%20does%20not%20have%20to%20be%20paid.%20Small%20overlaps%20are%20possible%2C%20e.g.%20a%20payment%20that%20is%20registered%20around%20the%20hand-over%20to%20the%20collection%20agency.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(ACTIVITY%2C%20CASE_ID%2C%20case_log_t6%2C%20event_log_t5)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20_cases%20%3D%20event_log_t5.groupby(CASE_ID)%0A%0A%20%20%20%20case_log_s3%20%3D%20case_log_t6.copy()%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20the%20sequence%20of%20activities%20of%20the%20case%20(its%20sequential%20variant)%0A%20%20%20%20case_log_s3%5B'seq_variant'%5D%20%3D%20_cases%5BACTIVITY%5D.agg(tuple)%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20the%20outstanding%20amount%20after%20the%20last%20event%20of%20the%20case%20(Task%202.5%2C%20Part%202)%0A%20%20%20%20case_log_s3%5B'final_outstanding_amount'%5D%20%3D%20_cases%5B'outstanding_amount'%5D.last()%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20outcome%201%3A%20the%20offender%20has%20paid%20everything%20that%20is%20due%0A%20%20%20%20case_log_s3%5B'paid'%5D%20%3D%20(%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20case_log_s3%5B'seq_variant'%5D.apply(lambda%20x%3A%20'Payment'%20in%20x)%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%26%20(case_log_s3%5B'final_outstanding_amount'%5D%20%3C%3D%200)%0A%20%20%20%20)%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20outcome%202%3A%20the%20unpaid%20fine%20is%20handed%20over%20to%20a%20collection%20agency%0A%20%20%20%20case_log_s3%5B'credit_collection'%5D%20%3D%20case_log_s3%5B'seq_variant'%5D.apply(lambda%20x%3A%20'Send%20for%20Credit%20Collection'%20in%20x)%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20outcome%203%3A%20the%20fine%20is%20dismissed%20by%20the%20prefecture%20(%23)%20or%20by%20the%20judge%20(G)%0A%20%20%20%20_dismissed_cases%20%3D%20event_log_t5.loc%5Bevent_log_t5%5B'dismissal'%5D.isin(%5B'%23'%2C%20'G'%5D)%2C%20CASE_ID%5D.unique()%0A%20%20%20%20case_log_s3%5B'dismissed'%5D%20%3D%20cas og_t5%2C%20'A10001'%2C%20_cols)%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%5D)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Task%203.1b%20-%20Result%0A%0A%20%20%20%20For%20each%20outcome%20we%20inspect%20a%20case%20with%20the%20most%20frequent%20sequence%20of%20activities%20of%20that%20outcome.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**%60paid%60%2C%20case%20A10005.**%20A%20fine%20of%2036%20is%20created%20on%2020.03.2007%20and%20paid%20in%20full%20one%20day%20later.%20There%20is%20no%20*Send%20Fine*%2C%20so%20no%20expenses%20arise%2C%20and%20no%20penalty.%20This%20is%20the%20typical%20paid%20case%3A%2046'315%20of%20the%2060'287%20paid%20cases%20consist%20of%20only%20*Create%20Fine*%20and%20*Payment*%2C%20and%2046'327%20paid%20cases%20were%20paid%20before%20the%20fine%20was%20sent.%20The%20process%20works%20best%20when%20the%20offender%20pays%20immediately.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**%60credit_collection%60%2C%20case%20A100.**%20A%20fine%20of%2035%20is%20created%20on%2002.08.2006%20and%20sent%20more%20than%20four%20months%20later%20(expenses%20of%2011).%20The%20notification%20is%20registered%20on%2015.01.2007.%20Exactly%2060%20days%20later%20the%20penalty%20is%20added%2C%20and%2082.50%20are%20outstanding%20(71.50%20%2B%2011).%20Nothing%20is%20ever%20paid%2C%20and%20on%2030.03.2009%2C%20two%20years%20after%20the%20penalty%2C%20the%20case%20is%20sent%20for%20credit%20collection.%20This%20is%20by%20far%20the%20most%20frequent%20path%20to%20credit%20collection%20(56'482%20of%2059'013%20cases)%3A%20the%20offender%20does%20not%20react%20at%20all.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**%60dismissed%60%2C%20case%20A10001.**%20A%20fine%20of%2036%20is%20sent%20with%20expenses%20of%2013%20and%20notified%20on%2025.07.2007.%20Eight%20days%20later%20the%20offender%20appeals%20to%20the%20prefecture%20(*Insert%20Date%20Appeal%20to%20Prefecture*).%20On%2023.09.2007%2C%20exactly%2060%20days%20after%20the%20notification%2C%20the%20penalty%20is%20added%20although%20the%20appeal%20is%20pending.%20One%20day%20later%20the%20appeal%20is%20sent%20to%20the%20prefecture%2C%20and%20this%20event%20carries%20the%20dismissal%20value%20%60%23%60.%20The%20case%20ends%20there.%2087%20are%20formally%20outstanding%20but%20no%20longer%20owed.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Findings%3A**%0A%0A%20%20%20%20-%20In%20the%20dismissed%20cases%20the%20penalty%20is%20almost%20always%20added%20(1'993%20of%202'073%20cases)%2C%20apparently%20automatically%2060%20days%20after%20the%20notification%20and%20regardless%20of%20a%20pending%20appeal.%20*Improvement%20of%20the%20process%3A*%20suspend%20the%20penalty%20while%20an%20appeal%20is%20pending.%0A%20%20%20%20-%20The%20dismissal%20by%20the%20prefecture%20is%20recorded%20on%20the%20*Send%20Appeal%20to%20Prefecture*%20event%2C%20and%20only%2084%20of%20the%202'073%20dismissed%20cases%20contain%20a%20*Receive%20Result%20Appeal%20from%20Prefecture*%20event.%20So%20the%20log%20does%20not%20show%20when%20the%20decision%20was%20taken.%20Either%20the%20attribute%20was%20updated%20afterwards%2C%20or%20the%20appeal%20is%20deemed%20accepted%20without%20an%20explicit%20result.%20*Recommendation%20data%20collection%3A*%20record%20the%20decision%20as%20an%20event%20of%20its%20own%20with%20its%20date.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(ACTIVITY%2C%20OUTCOMES%2C%20case_log_s3%2C%20event_log_t5%2C%20mo%2C%20show_case)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20_cols%20%3D%20%5BACTIVITY%2C%20'amount'%2C%20'expense'%2C%20'paymentAmount'%2C%20'dismissal'%2C%20'outstanding_amount'%5D%0A%20%20%20%20_several%20%3D%20case_log_s3%5Bcase_log_s3%5BOUTCOMES%5D.sum(axis%3D1)%20%3E%201%5D%0A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.vstack(%5B%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20mo.md(f%22Cases%20with%20more%20than%20one%20outcome%3A%20**%7Blen(_several)%7D**%22)%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20_several%5BOUTCOMES%20%2B%20%5B'final_outstanding_amount'%2C%20'seq_variant'%5D%5D%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20mo.md(%22**%60paid%60%20and%20%60credit_collection%60%3A%20case%20N35881**%2 s%20later%20the%20penalty%20is%20added%20anyway%20(174%20due)%2C%20and%20the%20offender%20pays%2095%20and%20then%2079%2C%20i.e.%20the%20full%20amount%20including%20the%20penalty.%20Either%20the%20dismissal%20value%20is%20wrong%2C%20or%20the%20offender%20paid%20a%20fine%20that%20had%20been%20dismissed%20and%20should%20get%20the%20money%20back.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Findings%3A**%0A%0A%20%20%20%20-%20Both%20combinations%20are%20contradictions%20and%20not%20legitimate%20double%20outcomes.%20They%20are%20rare%20(3%20cases)%2C%20but%20each%20of%20them%20is%20a%20potential%20complaint.%20*Improvement%20of%20the%20process%3A*%20check%20the%20outstanding%20amount%20and%20the%20dismissal%20status%20before%20a%20case%20is%20sent%20for%20credit%20collection%20and%20before%20a%20payment%20is%20accepted.%0A%20%20%20%20-%20Both%20cases%20with%20%60paid%60%20and%20%60credit_collection%60%20went%20through%20a%20rejected%20appeal.%20Is%20the%20hand-over%20to%20credit%20collection%20triggered%20differently%20after%20an%20appeal%3F%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(ACTIVITY%2C%20OUTCOMES%2C%20case_log_s3%2C%20event_log_t5%2C%20mo%2C%20pd%2C%20show_case)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20_cols%20%3D%20%5BACTIVITY%2C%20'amount'%2C%20'expense'%2C%20'paymentAmount'%2C%20'dismissal'%2C%20'outstanding_amount'%5D%0A%20%20%20%20_none%20%3D%20case_log_s3%5B~case_log_s3%5BOUTCOMES%5D.any(axis%3D1)%5D%0A%0A%20%20%20%20_last_activity%20%3D%20_none%5B'seq_variant'%5D.apply(lambda%20x%3A%20x%5B-1%5D).value_counts().rename('cases%20without%20outcome')%0A%20%20%20%20_variants%20%3D%20_none%5B'seq_variant'%5D.apply('%20%3E%20'.join).value_counts().head(5).rename('cases%20without%20outcome')%0A%0A%20%20%20%20_year%20%3D%20case_log_s3%5B'start_time'%5D.dt.tz_convert('Europe%2FRome').dt.year.rename('year%20of%20Create%20Fine')%0A%20%20%20%20_per_year%20%3D%20pd.DataFrame(%7B%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20'cases'%3A%20case_log_s3.groupby(_year).size()%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20'cases% 0penalty%3A%20**%7Bnum((_notified%20%26%20~_penalised).sum())%7D**%2C%20with%20a%20penalty%20but%20without%20a%20notification%3A%20**%7Bnum((~_notified%20%26%20_penalised).sum())%7D**%0A%20%20%20%20-%20*Payment*%20directly%20after%20*Insert%20Fine%20Notification*%3A%20**%7Bnum(len(_payment_after_notification))%7D**%2C%20of%20which%20**%7Bnum((_payment_after_notification%5B'outstanding_amount'%5D%20%3C%3D%200).sum())%7D**%20settle%20the%20amount%20due%0A%20%20%20%20-%20*Add%20penalty*%20directly%20after%20a%20*Payment*%3A%20**%7Bnum(len(_penalty_after_payment))%7D**%20cases%2C%20of%20which%20**%7Bnum((_penalty_after_payment%5B'outstanding_before'%5D%20%3C%3D%200).sum())%7D**%20had%20nothing%20outstanding%20before%20the%20penalty%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20mo.md(%22Most%20frequent%20outstanding%20amounts%20directly%20before%20a%20penalty%20that%20follows%20a%20payment%3A%22)%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20_penalty_after_payment%5B'outstanding_before'%5D.value_counts().head(5).rename('cases')%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%5D)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Task%204.2a%20-%20Result%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20main%20path%20of%20the%20hypothesis%20is%20clearly%20visible%20(thick%20arrows)%2C%20and%20all%20cases%20start%20with%20*Create%20Fine*.%20But%20three%20things%20are%20unexpected%20and%20should%20be%20investigated%3A%0A%0A%20%20%20%201.%20**One%20in%20five%20fines%20that%20are%20sent%20ends%20right%20there.**%2020'897%20of%20the%20103'987%20*Send%20Fine*%20events%20are%20the%20last%20event%20of%20their%20case.%20We%20expected%20every%20fine%20that%20is%20sent%20to%20be%20notified.%20Without%20a%20notification%20there%20is%20no%20penalty%20and%20no%20credit%20collection%2C%20so%20these%20fines%20are%20lost%20(see%20Task%203.1d).%0A%20%20%20%202.%20**Notification%20and%20penalty%20always%20come%20together.**%20*Insert%20Fine%20Notification*%20and%20*Add%20penalty*%20occur%20in%20exactly%20the%20same%2079'860%20cases.%20There%20is%20not%20a%20single%20fine%20that%20is%20notified%20and%20then%20paid%20without%20a%20penalty.%20A%20*Payment*%20directly%20after%20the%20notification%20occurs%203'902%20times%2C%20but%20only%2035%20of%20these%20payments%20settle%20the%20amount%20due%2C%20and%20all%203'902%20are%20followed%20by%20a%20penalty.%20We%20expected%20many%20offenders%20to%20pay%20within%20the%2060%20days%20after%20the%20notification.%20Is%20*Insert%20Fine%20Notification*%20perhaps%20only%20entered%20for%20fines%20that%20are%20still%20unpaid%20when%20the%20penalty%20is%20due%3F%0A%20%20%20%203.%20**A%20penalty%20is%20added%20after%20a%20payment%20(3'902%20cases).**%20In%203'866%20of%20these%20cases%20something%20was%20still%20outstanding%2C%20but%20typically%20only%20a%20few%20euros%20(the%20most%20frequent%20amounts%20are%203.25%2C%205.16%2C%205.60%20and%204.96)%3A%20the%20offender%20paid%20the%20fine%20but%20not%20all%20of%20the%20expenses.%20This%20small%20rest%20triggers%20a%20penalty%20that%20roughly%20doubles%20the%20fine.%20In%2036%20cases%20nothing%20was%20outstanding%20and%20the%20penalty%20was%20added%20anyway.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Hypothesis.**%20The%20main%20path%20is%20confirmed.%20Our%20three%20other%20expectations%20are%20not%3A%20a%20payment%20does%20not%20always%20end%20the%20case%20(in%20the%20map%20*Payment*%20has%20arrows%20to%20every%20activity%20except%20*Create%20Fine*)%2C%20not%20every%20fine%20that%20is%20sent%20is%20notified%2C%20and%20penalties%20are%20also%20added%20to%20fines%20on%20which%20something%20was%20paid.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(%0A%20%20%20%20ACTIVITY%2C%0A%20%20%20%20CASE_ID%2C%0A%20%20%20%20TIMESTAMP%2C%0A%20%20%20%20case_log_s3%2C%0A%20%20%20%20event_log_t5%2C%0A%20%20%20%20fine_object_variant%2C%0A%20%20%20%20mo%2C%0A%20%20%20%20pd%2C%0A%20%20%20%20show_case%2C%0A)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20%22follower%20filter%22%3A%20cases%20in%2 20payment%20equal%20to%20the%20fine%20amount%3A%20**%7Bnum((_paid%20%3D%3D%20_case_log%5B'initial_amount'%5D).sum())%7D**%2C%20higher%3A%20**%7Bnum((_paid%20%3E%20_case_log%5B'initial_amount'%5D).sum())%7D**%2C%20lower%3A%20**%7Bnum((_paid%20%3C%20_case_log%5B'initial_amount'%5D).sum())%7D**%0A%20%20%20%20-%20days%20between%20the%20payment%20and%20*Send%20Fine*%3A%20median%20**%7B_days.median()%3Ag%7D**%2C%20maximum%20%7B_days.max()%3Ag%7D%0A%20%20%20%20-%20outcome%20of%20these%20cases%20in%20Session%203%3A%20%7Bnum(case_log_s3.loc%5B_cases%2C%20'paid'%5D.sum())%7D%20%60paid%60%2C%20%7Bnum((~case_log_s3.loc%5B_cases%2C%20%5B'paid'%2C%20'credit_collection'%2C%20'dismissed'%5D%5D.any(axis%3D1)).sum())%7D%20without%20outcome%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20mo.md(%22**Case%20A127**%22)%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20show_case(event_log_t5%2C%20'A127'%2C%20%5BACTIVITY%2C%20'amount'%2C%20'expense'%2C%20'paymentAmount'%2C%20'outstanding_amount'%5D)%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%5D)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20_screenshot%20%3D%20mo.notebook_dir()%20%2F%20'disco_follower_filter.png'%0A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.image(src%3Dstr(_screenshot))%20if%20_screenshot.exists()%20else%20mo.md(%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%22**The%20screenshot%20%60disco_follower_filter.png%60%20is%20not%20there%20yet.**%20Save%20a%20screenshot%20of%20the%20Disco%20variants%20view%20%22%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%22after%20the%20Follower%20filter%20(*Payment*%20directly%20followed%20by%20*Send%20Fine*)%20under%20this%20name%20in%20the%20folder%20of%20this%20notebook.%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Task%204.2b%20-%20Result%0A%0A%20%20%20%20In%20Disco%20we%20add%20a%20**Follower%20filter**%20to%20the%20fine%20object%20sub-log%3A%20*Payment*%20directly%20followed%20by%20*Send%20Fine*.%20The%20Python%20cell%20above%20applies%20the%20same%20filter%20and%20gives%20the%20exact%20numbers.%20The%20filter%20selects%20569%20cases%20in%2010%20variants.%20The%20most%20frequent%20one%20is%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Create%20Fine%20%3E%20Payment%20%3E%20Send%20Fine**%20(362%20cases).%0A%0A%20%20%20%20It%20is%20unexpected%20because%20the%20fine%20is%20sent%20after%20it%20has%20been%20paid%2C%20and%20because%20the%20case%20then%20ends%20with%20*Send%20Fine*.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Task%204.2c%20-%20Result%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Case%20A127.**%20A%20fine%20of%2035%20is%20created%20on%2002.08.2006%20and%20paid%20in%20full%20two%20days%20later.%20Nothing%20is%20outstanding.%20Four%20months%20later%2C%20on%2012.12.2006%2C%20the%20fine%20is%20sent%20anyway.%20This%20adds%20expenses%20of%2011%2C%20which%20are%20never%20paid%2C%20and%20the%20case%20ends%20with%2011%20outstanding.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20case%20is%20typical%20for%20the%20variant%3A%20in%20312%20of%20the%20362%20cases%20the%20payment%20is%20exactly%20the%20fine%20amount%2C%20and%20the%20fine%20is%20sent%20a%20median%20of%2036%20days%20after%20the%20payment.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Possible%20explanations.**%20Either%20the%20step%20*Send%20Fine*%20does%20not%20check%20whether%20the%20fine%20has%20been%20paid%2C%20or%20the%20payment%20was%20entered%20into%20the%20system%20only%20after%20the%20fine%20had%20been%20sent%2C%20with%20the%20date%20of%20the%20payment%20as%20timestamp.%20The%20log%20cannot%20tell%20these%20two%20apart%2C%20because%20it%20has%20no%20separate%20timestamp%20for%20the%20registration%20of%20a%20payment.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Findings%3A**%0A%0A%20%20%20%20-%20The%20offender%20did%20everything%20right%20and%20still%20receives%20a%20notification%20and%20is%20charged%20its%20cost.%20*Improvement%20of%20the%20process%3A*%20check%20for%20payments%20immediately%20before%20sending%2C%20and%20do%20not%20charge%20expenses%20for%20a%20fine%20that%20was%20paid%20before%20it%20was%20sent.%0A%20%20%20%20-%20This%20also%20affects%20our%20outcome%20analysis%3A%20because%20of%20the%20unpaid%20expenses%2C%20343%20of%20the%20362%20cases%20have%20no%20outcome%20in%20Session%203%2C%20although%20the%20fine%20itself%20was%20paid.%20The%20share%20of%20%60paid%60%20cases%20is%20therefore%20slightly%20underestimated.%0A%20%20%20%20-%20*Recommendation%20data%20collection%3A*%20record%20when%20a%20payment%20was%20received%20and%20when%20it%20was%20registered.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%20Task%204.3%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Task%204.3%20-%20Model%20of%20the%20fine%20object%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Our%20current%20understanding%20of%20how%20the%20fine%20object%20**should**%20behave%3A%0A%0A%20%20%20%201.%20A%20fine%20is%20created.%0A%20%20%20%202.%20The%20offender%20can%20pay%20at%20every%20stage.%20A%20payment%2C%20possibly%20in%20several%20instalments%2C%20ends%20the%20case.%0A%20%20%20%203.%20As%20long%20as%20the%20fine%20is%20not%20paid%2C%20the%20police%20takes%20the%20next%20step%3A%20send%20the%20fine%2C%20register%20the%20notification%2C%20add%20the%20penalty%20and%20finally%20send%20the%20fine%20for%20credit%20collection%2C%20which%20also%20ends%20the%20case.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20As%20a%20workflow%20graph%2C%20with%20XOR%20gateways%20only%3A%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20From%20%7C%20To%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C---%7C---%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20Start%20event%20%7C%20*Create%20Fine*%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20*Create%20Fine*%20%7C%20gateway%20G1%20(split)%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20G1%20%7C%20*Send%20Fine*%2C%20or%20gateway%20J%20(join%20in%20front%20of%20*Payment*)%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20*Send%20Fine*%20%7C%20gateway%20G2%20(split)%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20G2%20%7C%20*Insert%20Fine%20Notification*%2C%20or%20J%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20*Insert%20Fine%20Notification*%20%7C%20gateway%20G3%20(split)%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20G3%20%7C%20*Add%20penalty*%2C%20or%20J%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20*Add%20penalty*%20%7C%20gateway%20G4%20(split)%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20G4%20%7C%20*Send%20for%20Credit%20Collection*%2C%20or%20J%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20J%20%7C%20*Payment*%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20*Payment*%20%7C%20gateway%20G5%20(split)%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20G5%20%7C%20gateway%20E%20(join%20in%20front%20of%20the%20end%20event)%2C%20or%20back%20to%20J%20for%20a%20further%20payment%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20*Send%20for%20Credit%20Collection*%20%7C%20E%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20%7C%20E%20%7C%20End%20event%20%7C%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20model%20allows%20exactly%20these%20sequences%2C%20where%20*Payment*%20can%20be%20repeated%3A%20*Create%20Fine%20%3E%20Payment*%2C%20*Create%20Fine%20%3E%20Send%20Fine%20%3E%20Payment*%2C%20*Create%20Fine%20%3E%20Send%20Fine%20%3E%20Insert%20Fine%20Notification%20%3E%20Payment*%2C%20*Create%20Fine%20%3E%20Send%20Fine%20%3E%20Insert%20Fine%20Notification%20%3E%20Add%20penalty%20%3E%20Payment*%20and%20*Create%20Fine%20%3E%20Send%20Fine%20%3E%20Insert%20Fine%20Notification%20%3E%20Add%20penalty%20%3E%20Send%20for%20Credit%20Collection*.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Soundness.**%20The%20graph%20has%20one%20start%20event%20and%20one%20end%20event%2C%20every%20node%20lies%20on%20a%20path%20from%20the%20start%20to%20the%20end%2C%20and%20all%20seven%20gateways%20are%20XOR%20gateways.%20An%20XOR%20split%20passes%20the%20token%20to%20exactly%20one%20branch%2C%20so%20there%20is%20always%20exactly%20one%20token.%20Without%20AND%20gateways%20there%20can%20be%20no%20deadlock%20(no%20AND%20join%20waits%20for%20a%20second%20token)%20and%20no%20lack%20of%20synchronization%20(no%20flow%20ever%20carries%20two%20tokens).%20The%20loop%20at%20*Payment*%20can%20always%20be%20left%20through%20G5.%20The%20model%20is%20therefore%20sound.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20next%20cell%20compares%20this%20model%20with%20the%20log.%20The%20cell%20after%20it%20checks%20the%20BPMN%20file%20that%20we%20created%20with%20bpmn.io.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(fine_object_variant%2C%20mo%2C%20pd)%3A%0A%20% %20*Send%20for%20Credit%20Collection*%20after%20a%20payment%20(1'523%20and%20522%20cases)%20and%20*Send%20Fine*%20after%20a%20payment%20(362%20cases).%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Decisions%20we%20took%20for%20the%20model%3A**%0A%0A%20%20%20%20-%20*Payment*%20is%20a%20single%20task%20with%20a%20loop%2C%20so%20that%20payments%20in%20instalments%20are%20allowed%20at%20every%20stage.%0A%20%20%20%20-%20A%20payment%20is%20allowed%20between%20*Insert%20Fine%20Notification*%20and%20*Add%20penalty*%20without%20a%20penalty%2C%20because%20an%20offender%20who%20pays%20within%20the%20deadline%20should%20not%20be%20penalised.%20In%20the%20log%20this%20almost%20never%20happens%20(Task%204.2a).%0A%20%20%20%20-%20We%20use%20no%20AND%20gateway.%20From%20the%20point%20of%20view%20of%20the%20fine%20the%20activities%20are%20strictly%20ordered%2C%20and%20nothing%20happens%20in%20parallel.%0A%20%20%20%20-%20The%20model%20is%20deliberately%20strict.%20It%20does%20not%20contain%20the%20dead%20ends%20that%20we%20see%20in%20the%20log%2C%20because%20we%20regard%20them%20as%20leakage%20and%20not%20as%20intended%20behaviour.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0Aif%20__name__%20%3D%3D%20%22__main__%22%3A%0A%20%20%20%20app.run()%0A
